title: Bare d-value series as ranked references into the live material history
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Read dan/dain/daiin/daiiin as references of depth 1/2/3/4 into already introduced live material individuals, rather than counts or grades. The complete f83r.27 would select the second most recent live portion, heat it, and split it into two named outputs. This changes the patient relative to P06, conditional on its unconfirmed prior material inventory.

design.access: Existing primary reports and their already exposed derived readings only. No raw target corpus, image, new admission, reserve, external contact or current qoqokeey/repetition experiment inspected. No target test or decoder built.
design.claim_ceiling: All semantic values are provisional hypotheses. Zero confirmed words. Structural composition, spaces, whole-form residuals and entry effects constrain a future shared writer but do not identify its meanings. This is raw retention, not experimental selection.
design.retained_stops: GDT913/914/915/916/925/928/930/947/949/970/979/980 and GDT981 remain unchanged. No universal adjacency agreement, source-copy sequence, free automaton, per-token gloss, arbitrary filler or new allomorphic exception is licensed.
design.navigation: Current route and composition context read. Bounded ideas search, ideas duplicates and route-check used as navigation; returned claim-bearing primaries read where named below. Search absence is not proof of novelty. Later queries were blocked by concurrently stale EXPERIMENT_INDEX.tsv; no refresh performed.

target_nomination.reading: For the second most recently introduced live portion: heat it; split it into a fraction and a fraction.
target_nomination.ownership_limit: P06 owns the written group sequence and its conditional reference trace. The liquid/mixture/fraction meanings and physical identities are hypotheses. Earlier incomplete actions and unknown groups prevent certification of this initial inventory.

finite_provisional_writer.reference_rule: A reference selects the k-th most recently introduced live material individual; it is a referring expression, not itself a physical operation. References and repeated mentions do not refresh introduction order. Unavailable depth is undefined, never supplied by an invisible object.

action_groups.qokeedy: split the selected live material into the ensuing typed output declarations

finite_provisional_writer.output_group: Each shckhedy in the immediate output-declaration run creates one new fraction individual. At least two outputs are required for a split. The run boundary and non-output words must be supplied by the same prospective full writer; no fixed paragraph width is required.
finite_provisional_writer.sequence: A program is a finite sequence of declarations, references and actions. A selected referent persists until consumed, replaced by another explicit reference, or the independently owned record boundary is reached. A split consumes its input and adds its output individuals in written order. Heat preserves identity.
finite_provisional_writer.quantity_rule: All split outputs have positive quantity and their sum equals the input. No equal-halves assertion follows from two equal written type names.
finite_provisional_writer.surface_limit: Only the four bare d-wholes receive this proposed rank interpretation. qodaiin and all other families remain unassigned, not automatically decomposed. One shared rank map is proposed, not a per-line index or an action ordinal.

complete_conditional_execution.prestate: Older live individual E@f83r.25:3, then newer E@f83r.26:5, assuming the P06 C inventory and no intervening unread change.
complete_conditional_execution.dain: Select E@f83r.25:3, the older liquid candidate.
complete_conditional_execution.qokeedy_shckhedy_shckhedy: Consume the selected individual and create two distinct fraction individuals whose positive masses sum to its mass. Leave E@f83r.26:5 unchanged.
complete_conditional_execution.P06_contrast: P06 instead splits the latest mixture E@f83r.26:5 at this locus. The current card does not alter P06 or claim its prior failures are repaired.

concrete_new_consequences: Depth is an index of referents, not an amount: dain alone introduces neither two portions nor a second heating event.
If an unrelated material is newly introduced before the reference, the selected individual may change; merely changing its amount or degree does not change the index.
If an earlier action consumed the indexed material, a later reference cannot recover it without a written new introduction.

A series of bare ranks may name the same individual repeatedly without advancing an ordinal counter. GDT686 f38v.6 daiin daiiin dain dain would require at least four live candidates, with its final two references co-referring; this is a prospective obligation, not a tested success.

The full line has an inherited but explicit material prerequisite. If the surrounding paragraph cannot establish it under the same writer, the whole reading fails rather than receiving a free initial stock.
design.structural_link_specific: A directed family could encode reference-class plus bounded rank while whole-form identity remains significant. Only the four attested whole forms are mapped here; no general i-count alphabet or phonetic claim is made. The jointly recovered group syntax must distinguish a reference from an output declaration and preserve record-level context.
predecessor_review: GDT686 primary enumerates dan/dain/daiin/daiiin and distinguishes grade, amount and class-number possibilities. Its renderer defaults are historical hypotheses, not independent meanings. The current alternative makes a definite identity prediction beyond ordered value stages.

P06 C primary tracks linear split/merge resources, only 6 of 19 action cards complete; dain and chedy are open in its f83r.27. The present card supplies a prospective referential reading there without declaring all of P4 solved.

P12 primary rejects naive latest-any-participant L0 at f83r.6:7 but leaves latest-material and first-topic alternatives tied. It also shows type correctness cannot decide REUSE versus FRESH identities. An explicit ranked reference is different from automatically choosing latest or first.

P12 missing initial materials and recipients, P06 incompleteness, W94 mass-identity collapse and IDEA124 resource-program non-discrimination remain in force. No free material insertion, later-line backward introduction or hidden loss is proposed.
likely_failure: The rank map is chosen after seeing an attractive complete line and has not been transferred; no evidential reward is claimed.
The surrounding P4 inventory is not fully read and may not contain four or even two certified live individuals.
The old liquid, mixture and fraction classes may be wrong; equal surface types do not establish equal physical identities.
This model may already fail an early dain/daiin occurrence with insufficient explicit antecedents. No exceptions for inconvenient first uses are allowed.
A complete shared introduction/output grammar is still required. Free noun introductions would make the availability test meaningless.
design.data_needed: Existing admitted full paragraphs and their alternative readings, a frozen global rule for explicit material introduction and individuation, and complete output/declaration boundaries. No new folio or confirmed seed word is required to explore; however, old report guesses cannot certify the input stock.
